name: Gottfried Rahn
source:
Lackadaisical Battlefield Artist

A laid-back and irresponsible war artist who regularly disavows any semblance of military regulation or authority. His best-kept secfret is that he is a driven and professional man, intensely proud both of his Meindi gypsy heritage and his lucrative employment with the government.

Elfriede and Gottfried develop an antagonistic rapport almost immediately, and he is quick to shoehorn caddish professions of admiration and undying love into their back-and-forth. Of course, it's clearly just good humour. Clearly. Right?
